paraphrase: For fixed-roster Ontic semantics with arbitrary total predicates and existence-guarded universal quantification, box-forall to forall-box holds for all predicates/worlds exactly when domains increase along accessibility; the reverse transfer holds exactly when domains decrease. Increasing domains exclude the existing actual-plus-accessible-absence ContingentAt profile. In the unchanged PSR.ContingentOnly ontology, accessibility is universal, false is necessary, and true is contingent at false; both domain policies and both transfers fail. This is an explicit semantic correspondence and one joint countercontrol, not a theorem that S5 removes contingency, a general quantified proof calculus, or metaphysical possibility. Generic laws permit empty domains and require no frame, population, excluded-middle, causal or temporal premise. Intended and actual root-premise delta none.
